description: `SqsAsyncBatchManager` now groups buffered requests by queue URL and request override configuration equality instead of a 32-bit hash of the configuration, so requests carrying different credentials providers (or any other non-equal override configuration) are never batched - and therefore never signed - together. Batch calls for requests that carry a request override configuration are now also addressed to the real queue URL instead of the queue URL concatenated with the configuration's hash code.
